Druckbetankung

Refueling by forcing fuel under pressure through a closed coupling to aircraft tanks.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Druckbetankung?

In this glossary, Druckbetankung refers to: Refueling by forcing fuel under pressure through a closed coupling to aircraft tanks.

How is Druckbetankung used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Vorfeldkontrolle, Gate fünf: Druckbetankung läuft; Bremsen bleiben gesetzt, bis Bonding-Kabel bestätigt."

Why does Druckbetankung matter in aviation?

Druckbetankung matters because it supports clear communication in Fueling Deicing contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

Refueling by forcing fuel under pressure through a closed coupling to aircraft tanks.

Operational example

Apron Control, gate five: pressure refueling in progress; aircraft brakes must remain set until bonding cable confirmed connected.

Localized term

Localized example
